_about: Voiceover lines for marketing/*.mp4 (15 s each). Each line starts at `at` seconds and must end before `end` (the scene change). `style` is the acting direction. Brand names are spelled in Arabic so the voice says them naturally.
dialect: You are a native Lebanese Arabic speaker from Beirut, narrating an Instagram reel in the second person to the viewer. Speak natural, everyday Lebanese dialect (Levantine), never Egyptian and never Modern Standard Arabic; say ق as a glottal stop like Beirutis do. Sound like a real person talking to a friend: relaxed, warm, conversational rhythm, natural breaths and small pauses, a smile in the voice. Never theatrical, never a TV announcer. English words (ProHost, Premium, app, booking, request, shift, clinic, studio, meeting room, monthly, yearly) are said naturally in English, the way Lebanese professionals say them.
